title: Louisiana Nextlink tower availability remains separate from measured adoption
summary: Retain the Nextlink adoption signal In Review. State and provider releases support the May tower activation and availability for 104 Bossier locations, not a measured subscriber count for that cohort. The newer supplemental-round announcement is a separate eligibility process.
evidence_note: Actual November 21 inspection catches up October 9, preserving the September 9 primary schedule and September 10 decision. No qualifying fixed-cohort subscription or take-rate return was retrieved in this bounded review; that does not establish nonexistence or zero customers. Company-wide subscriber totals and deployment forecasts cannot be allocated to 104 eligible locations. Two listed article bodies remained inaccessible; their older observations were not reused as fresh evidence. No address, account, challenge or customer-data query was submitted.
publication_effect: Local dated context only. Signal remains In Review; prior decisions and exactly thirteen cycle identities are retained. No provider-cohort outcome, named-file admission or release authorization.
